comparison.scope: Read all nine latest submitted casual prompts and compare their light faces.

face.why: Smooth serpentine outline: elongated oval, rounded medium eyes, soft jaw and small mouth; distinguish from recently reviewed pointed and broader faces.

casual.scene: Inside an empty planetarium event foyer at violet dusk, a costumed adult star-show hostess gives a small relaxed greeting wave, other hand resting separately beside her hip. Complete head, hands and shoes visible against a softly illuminated celestial ceiling; no other people.
casual.outfit: Opaque white sleeveless fitted event mini dress with navy curved seam piping, secure sweetheart bodice and blue short asymmetric chiffon capelet, white ankle boots, tiny fin-shaped silver ear studs. Bare shoulders arms and legs, fully covered chest and pelvis; fashion costume, no armor.

casual.scene: At home beside a low indoor water-garden bowl in fresh morning window light, kneeling on a thick cushion and carefully repositioning a smooth pebble with one hand while the other rests open on a separate wooden ledge. Both complete hands clearly connected to forearms inside crop; aquatic leaves only, no animals.
casual.outfit: Opaque pale blue halter crop tank, ivory high-waisted relaxed linen shorts, small white bead bracelet. Bare shoulders arms and midriff; simple personal hobby clothes, no armor or large head ornaments.

casual.scene: Alone on a wide coastal train window seat during soft rainy afternoon, seated with supported feet and gently turned toward viewer, reading a plain blank-covered travel journal held open with both hands apart. Both whole hands and head visible, sea and gray cliffs outside.
casual.outfit: Opaque navy sleeveless V-neck fitted top and high-waisted white pleated culottes, tiny pale blue pendant. Bare arms shoulders and upper chest, secure neckline, no armor, fin headpieces or costume.
